# Clovelly Watch pricing

> **These prices are provisional.** They are charged as listed, and may change before Watch is generally available.

Watch spends credits from your organization's prepaid balance, a credit being one dollar, only for completed work: 1 credit for a merge that changes your monitors, 5 credits for an alert investigated with an issue opened, 20 credits for a fix pull request, and nothing else costs a credit ([watch-pricing.md](watch-pricing.md)). These prices are provisional: they are charged as listed, and may change before Watch is generally available.

| Completed work | Credits |
|---|---|
| Monitors written for a merged pull request | 1 |
| An alert triaged as noise | 0 |
| An alert found already fixed at your default branch's head | 0 |
| An alert investigated, with an issue opened | 5 |
| A fix pull request opened, its test failing before and passing after | 20 |

A credit is one dollar of the same prepaid balance your sandboxes draw on. Nothing else spends credits: sending telemetry, monitors that do not fire, an alert that is a duplicate of one whose fix is open, an alert held while your balance is empty, and a session that fails or reaches its model budget spend no credits (machine time, below, is apart). A job claimed twice spends once.

## The model is included

Credits include the model's tokens: every session reaches Anthropic through our gateway, with our key, and there is no bring-your-own-key option. Each job has a token budget of ours ($2.00 for a monitors job, $25.00 for an alert job), and one organization's jobs spend at most $100.00 on the model in a day; a session at its budget ends without a result and spends no credits.

## Sessions

Sessions run in confidential sandboxes, and the machine time they use is yours, on its own line. In customer-held mode they run in your own environment's `watch` sub-environment, an ordinary one: its cells are metered and billed to you as every cell is, and credits cover only the work. In hosted mode they run in an environment we hold for you; each finished UTC day, Watch charges your balance what the runtime billed that environment, at the runtime's own prices, shown apart from work on the Spend page. Machine time is charged whatever a job's outcome.

## The hosted fee

In hosted mode Watch also charges a hosted fee of $1.63 for each UTC day your organization is set up and Watch is on, about $49 a month, charged once the day has ended and never for the day you turn Watch off or the days it is off; customer-held mode has no hosted fee.

## Turning Watch off

Finished work is charged when you turn Watch off, and nothing after: Watch stops taking work, drops what is queued, refuses the outcome of anything still running, posts every pending charge, and only then ends its access to your balance. Whatever could not be posted at that moment is written off by us.

## At zero

At a zero balance no job is started and new alerts are held, while telemetry is still received and monitors still evaluated, so nothing is lost. When credit arrives (a top-up, or automatic recharge at your low-balance level), held alerts are worked through as the hourly limit allows. Credit is bought on the console's Billing tab ([billing.md](https://github.com/clovelly-io/clovelly/blob/main/docs/billing.md)).
